senses.gloss: (cmp. קָרַס) [to be joined, v. קֶרֶשׁ I,] to become solid, congeal, contract.
units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 4">Gen. R. s. 4</cite>; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 1:1:23">Y. Ber. I, 2ᶜ</cite> bot. <he>ובשני קָרְשׁוּ</he>, v. <cite ref="L00333"><he>לַח</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 1:1:23">Ib.</cite> <he>יִקְרַשׁ הרקיע</he> let the heavens congeal.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 33">Gen. R. s. 33</cite> <he>עמודים … בצנה שלא יִקְרְשׁוּ</he> marble columns covered with carpets in the winter, lest they contract (and crack), v. <cite ref="S02111"><he>קָרַס</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Pesachim 5:5">Pes. V, 5</cite> <he>ויקרש הדם</he> and the blood may congeal; a. fr.—Part. pass. <he>קָרוּשׁ</he>.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Niddah 3:1:2">Y. Nidd. III, beg. 50ᶜ</cite> <he>דם הוא שהוא ק׳ וכ׳</he> it is blood which congealed and formed a lump.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat 2:1:21">Y. Sabb. II, 4ᵈ</cite> <he>כל שמתיכין אותו ואינו ק׳</he> whatever you melt, and it becomes not solid again.
<cite ref="Sukkah 12a:4">Succ. 12ᵃ</cite> <he>יין ק׳ הוא משניר וכ׳</he> it means a jelly of wine from Senir that resembles fig cakes.
<cite ref="Tosefta Chullin 6:7">Tosef. Ḥull. VI, 7</cite> <he>השוחט וה׳ וכ׳</he> (ed. Zuck. <he>והקדיש</he>, corr. acc.) if one slaughters and allows the blood to congeal.
